intro_section.p_4: We built Three Acts after forking the same starter for the fifth client in a row. Every project needed the same shape — a fast public site, a place for a non-technical editor to make changes, and a way to sell a handful of products — rebuilt from scratch each time. Three Acts is that shape, done once, done properly, and left open for you to configure rather than rebuild.
